applicability.scope: Wording and verdict rules for any public performance or quality claim produced from an RSI campaign
applicability.prerequisites: A completed campaign with pinned baseline and candidate SHAs and an evidence tree; the rules themselves carry no numeric threshold
applicability.input_contract: A claim draft, the campaign RunSpec and its evidence tree under evidence/<campaign-id>/
applicability.produced_artifact: A claim sentence in the pinned form, or a refusal when the campaign verdict is not PASS
failure_modes: Claim asserted before the campaign reaches PASS with artifacts
Baseline or candidate SHA written into a shared template, skill or default CI environment
Microbenchmark result presented as end-to-end completion
A lesson transferred across an unverified repo x revision x backend x device x model x scenario tuple
applicability.refusal_point: Refuses any public claim lacking a PASS verdict and artifacts under evidence/, and refuses numeric thresholds because thresholds belong to the campaign

recommendations: Keep campaign SHAs in the acceptance issue; a shared template that carries them will be wrong for the next campaign.
Write the verdict from the evidence tree before writing the claim sentence.
Treat each repo x revision x backend x device x model x scenario tuple as an independent claim.
limitations: States wording and verdict rules only; it selects no numeric gate and validates no measurement.
SIAS plane boundaries constrain where a change belongs, not whether it is correct.
